fields.era: campaign era, or all for a series spine
fields.owners: cast ids the arc belongs to

note: Vanta's three seasons and prequel as soft arcs for the director (requirements "The director"). How hard it steers toward them follows the campaign's hand setting, and it never writes the player's actions: a player who changes things changes them, and good outcomes are not guaranteed. The source's endings are one way it can go. House rules from the source hold whatever happens: Austin's wolf's name is never told, Piper's boutique name stays secret until the end of senior year, Kim never says "Mom" until she chooses to.

arcs.name: The bonded circle
arcs.summary: Series spine A. Season One names Piper's want, Season Two builds it, Season Three prices it and seals a smaller, real form.
beats: Named: Piper admits the want to herself
Pitched: "I want to build a bonded circle. You are in it."
A conditional yes from Kim, with Michael as a node he defines
Built in junior year, wounded by Kim's suite year
Sealed at the senior equinox, smaller than dreamed

arcs.name: Institutions that claim
arcs.summary: Series spine B: the fae courts, the Boston lineage, the Crane family and the DED. Season One opens each front, Season Two sends auditors, Season Three holds hearings.
beats: Callum's visit; Genevieve's layover; the Crane gala list; Whitestone's 1984
The auditor, the review board, the cold case
The hearings, and every claim answered

arcs.name: Terms and Conditions
arcs.summary: The prequel, June to August 2009: housing letters in cream envelopes put Jason and Piper in one Nexus unit, one door, one bedroom. All three couples are sitting on the same news.
beats: The phone call both of them rehearse
The bragging problem: do we tell the others?
Preview day: a too-smooth steward and a radiator warm in July
The convergence: everyone had the same secret

arcs.name: Kindling
arcs.summary: Jason pitches the support group he has drafted for eleven months; the name collides with the Ember Circle and Whitestone renames it.
beats: The pitch, and Halvers building a paper trail
Whitestone: "I attempted something like this in 1984."
First meeting on the Observatory roof: Graham hostile, Iona crying and allowed to finish
Early-career mistakes: Christine stands up and talks for eleven minutes

arcs.name: Callum and the betrothal
arcs.summary: Callum arrives unannounced during Rina's Grove shift and stays a gracious week; her forgeries sit seven feet from his tea.
beats: The oolong from a grove she knows by name
"An old friend visited." Austin lets the lie stand.

arcs.name: @HumanInterest
arcs.summary: Amanda launches the account she came to Havenbrooke to build, pitching each of the eight in turn and never Michael.
beats: The pitch tour: Austin's one-syllable no, Jason's viral consent refusal, Christine's yes at forty percent
"You're exactly what I hoped you'd be."
An exposure-fatigue tip in her inbox
Eight hundred words: publish under her own name, and leave Michael's out

arcs.name: The Harvest Howl
arcs.summary: The Alpha Gamma and Sigma Theta Hex party on the north practice fields, Halloween Saturday. More mixed-species couples start here than anywhere.
beats: Amanda in camera mode, then a locked bathroom
Petra: "You pour for everyone. Who pours for you?"
Rina gone into Ironroot Woods for an hour

arcs.name: Dethroned
arcs.summary: Dorian's polite challenge letter; Austin has the votes and does not want the job.
beats: A 3 a.m. dish argument settled in eight minutes
Paula's floor: "You don't have to win."

arcs.name: The feed-swap
arcs.summary: Piper's standing offer, eleven months on the table, accepted: a negotiated feed-swap with Vivian Corrigan.
beats: Three negotiation meetings and a written protocol
Night two: the channels blur and Piper's hands end it
Ninety seconds that Jason has to live with

arcs.name: The scent that does not belong
arcs.summary: Austin maps a bitten lycan's recon loops tightening toward Rina's Grove shifts and finds the name Silas Varn.
beats: Ashworth: "Let's see what it is before we report it."
Silas expelled; the lineage question left open

arcs.name: Runway and crash
arcs.summary: A Manhattan show needs Piper's charm work; five late nights at Stitch Hall; then the lithium drifts and Christine crashes into Thanksgiving.
beats: The show and the upgraded contract
A fox tattoo, an unnegotiated feed, a 2 a.m. confession
Pale Press at 11:17 p.m.: Paula stands up first
Stabilization, and the dream bleed into Piper's sleep

arcs.name: Ink
arcs.summary: Three weeks on the Evermere protocol and Michael's rib tattoo goes warm; Bex finds the heartbreak lock in her logbook.
beats: Removal needs a witch with a trust bond: Kim
Their first real fight, about him, not the kink

arcs.name: Nobody goes home
arcs.summary: Winter break 2009: everyone has a reason not to leave, and Piper makes room without saying so.
beats: Never Have I Ever on Christmas Eve
Kim arriving on day six through a snowstorm

arcs.name: The proposition
arcs.summary: Piper names the circle to Jason, then pitches it to Kim and Michael. Christine is left out, and the reason matters.
beats: Three calls with Hanae: "A bonded circle is built, not found."
A typed outline over cold tea
Jason's yes, sent away for three days, comes back

arcs.name: We'll see
arcs.summary: Genevieve arrives on a layover that exists on no itinerary, already in touch with Thorne-Ashford about the suite.
beats: Harper's, Michael in Jason's blazer: "I want to still be in love with her."
Kim interrupts her mother for the first time
The window held open to the end of junior year

arcs.name: Sealskin
arcs.summary: Mairead's sealskin is gone from a chest whose ward never fired. Ashworth puts Austin on it with Bryn Callow.
beats: Her hair going brittle by Saturday
Aurelio at the Stag & Thistle: "Look three lines down."
The warded search of Crane Hill; Gideon arrested in Providence
Scholarships frozen, Phi Sigma Nox under review, a cold-case file on an older skin

arcs.name: Equinox
arcs.summary: The spring rite. The presiding alumna is Oriane Dupré. Season One's cliffhanger.
beats: Kim tells Piper everything at Pale Press
Kim tells Michael the true shape of it and asks for something new

arcs.name: Lake Effect
arcs.summary: A week in a rented house on Seneca Lake before everyone scatters; Kim hands Piper her unsent answer to read.
beats: Conditions spoken: slow, Michael a chosen node, revocable, nothing until fall
The bark laugh from the porch

arcs.name: The court auditor
arcs.summary: Maera Silveth arrives from the Eastern Seelie court. The forgeries are found; the grove is frozen; the withering begins.

arcs.name: The feeding scandal and the DED review
arcs.summary: A feeding incident on campus brings a DED review board down on Kindling.
beats: Kindling survives, funded and co-led with Leona

arcs.name: Kneel
arcs.summary: Austin learns to kneel with Petra and hands what he learned to Rina at Petra's graduation.

arcs.name: The suite
arcs.summary: Kim accepts the ritual-leadership suite on her own terms and steps back from the circle.

arcs.name: The older sealskin
arcs.summary: A Crane cracks the cold case. Lucian is wounded, not felled.

arcs.name: Chosen, not wanted
arcs.summary: Instagram launches on October 6, 2010. Joaquin sees Amanda from the angle where she is real.

arcs.name: Easter
arcs.summary: Deirdre's illness comes out at Easter. The summer capstone is at her house in Pennsylvania.

arcs.name: Severance
arcs.summary: The court hearing in September: Rina is freed and severed, and dying by inches without ground.

arcs.name: The re-anchoring
arcs.summary: The series climax: Rina re-anchors at the junction under Nexus at the spring equinox. The dorm was the destination all along.

arcs.name: Siphon
arcs.summary: Paula's siphon comes out. The year is repair: changed, not broken.

arcs.name: Deirdre's decline
arcs.summary: Deirdre dies in February. The twins hold. Her letter stays unopened in the hall drawer.

arcs.name: Without a villain
arcs.summary: Kim and Michael, the steadiest couple, end over winter with nobody to blame.

arcs.name: Caps
arcs.summary: Offers, the shop lease and the boutique name revealed at last, graduation, and the third floor one more time.
